experiment_design.goal: Evaluate whether app+OS+eBPF evidence improves next Top-3 app prediction and whether MAPLE scheduler actions improve launch/pressure metrics.
experiment_design.ground_truth: Each sample has a hidden next-app Top-3 generated by the experiment persona. MAPLE only receives the observed input app sequence plus naturally collected eBPF/system evidence; ground truth is used only after inference for scoring.
experiment_design.real_device_operation: For every sample, MEMO actually launches the input apps on the rooted phone, collects raw libbpf eBPF and foreground app samples, compresses them into timeline windows, runs MAPLE, then executes scheduler_bits.

personas.description: communication-heavy behavior; after chat/network apps, camera or sharing apps are plausible next actions
browser/productivity behavior; after reading/searching, communication or media follow-up is plausible
media/display behavior; after browsing or playback, communication/camera/media follow-up is plausible
